residual_zh.hook_zh: “类”指相似的东西，“推”指推测。也就是从相似的先例推测出来的方法。
residual_zh.hook_en: In the Japanese name, 類 means "similar" and 推 means "infer": the method infers from similar precedents.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “理”是条理，“念”是心中始终怀有的想法。拆开来看，可以读作“作为经营的条理而始终坚持的想法”。
residual_zh.hook_en: In the Japanese term, 理 means a guiding path and 念 means a thought held in mind. Split apart, it reads as a thought kept in mind as the guiding path of management.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 从“人工费”的“费”到“人力资本”的“本”。看法从花掉就没了的东西，变成了作为本钱不断增值的东西。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese wording moves from the 費 (expense) in 人件費, personnel costs, to the 本 (principal) in 人的資本, human capital. People stop being seen as something spent and gone and become capital to build up.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语的“次”表示顺序；它是继蒸汽、电力、计算机之后的第 4 个转折点，所以叫“第4次”。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese 次 marks order: this is the fourth turning point after steam, electricity, and computers, hence "4th."

residual_zh.hook_zh: [[jp:粗利益]]里的“粗”是“粗略、大致”的意思，可以记成还没细细扣除各项费用之前、粗略算出的第一道利润。
residual_zh.hook_en: The 粗 in [[jp:粗利益]] means "rough" or "approximate", so think of it as the rough first profit before the finer deductions are made.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “固定”就是放在原处、不去移动。
residual_zh.hook_en: “Fixed” (固定) means set in place and not moved.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “意匠”的“匠”指工匠。从字面记：工匠倾注在造型上的设计巧思。
residual_zh.hook_en: The 匠 in 意匠 means craftsman. Remember it as the design care a craftsman puts into a shape.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语「勘定」就是记账的「账」。把钱的进出记入账簿的核心部分叫勘定系，从字面就能读出来。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese 勘定 (kanjō) means bookkeeping accounts, so 勘定系 is literally the part that books money in and out at the core.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语“利活用”是把“利用”和“活用”合在一起的词。从名字就能看出，它讲的是如何使用，而不是如何开发。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese word 利活用 joins 利用 (use) and 活用 (put to good use). The name itself tells you the document is about using AI, not building it.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语[[jp:企画]]中的“企”字，据说源于人踮起脚尖眺望远方的样子。可以把它和预见未来、制定计划的工序联系起来。
residual_zh.hook_en: The character 企 in [[jp:企画]] is said to come from the figure of a person on tiptoe gazing into the distance. Link that image to a stage that looks ahead and plans.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “率”是比率的率，把概率读成以全体为分母的比例。
residual_zh.hook_en: The 率 in 確率 means a rate, so read a probability as a share with the whole as the denominator.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “列”是排成一列的列。排成一列就有了前后之分。
residual_zh.hook_en: The 列 in 順列 means a line, and once things stand in a line there is a front and a back.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “组”是分组的组。组里没有先后顺序。
residual_zh.hook_en: The 組 in 組合せ means a team or group, and a group has no order inside it.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语写作「推定」：「推」是推测，「定」是确定。从手头的一部分出发，去确定整体的数值。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese word 推定 combines 推 (to infer) and 定 (to fix). You start from the part in hand and pin down a value for the whole.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 把“汇总”拆开来读：先“汇”集数据，再“总”计出数值，两个字正好对应这项操作的两个步骤。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese word 集計 joins 集 (gather) and 計 (measure), naming the two steps of the job: collect the records, then compute the figures.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语“尺度”原本指量长度用的尺子。尺子种类不同，能量的东西也不同，从字面就能读出这层意思。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese word 尺度 originally meant a ruler for measuring length, and different rulers can measure different things.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “标本”指从整体中抽取的样本，可以联想成从连续的波形中抽取样本点的工作。
residual_zh.hook_en: The kanji 標本 means a specimen taken from a larger whole, which links to picking sample points out of a continuous wave.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “量子”在物理中指不连续的最小量，可以联想成把值放到一格一格刻度上的工作。
residual_zh.hook_en: The kanji 量子 is the physics word for a quantum, the smallest step-like amount, which links to placing values onto separate marks on a scale.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语名称里的“量”表示用数来表示。是变成数值的特征，所以叫特征量。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese name ends in 量 ("quantity"), meaning something expressed as a number: a characteristic turned into a value.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语写作“演算子”，和“原子”“因子”一样带“子”字，可以理解为承担运算的小部件。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese word 演算子 ends in 子, the same character as in 原子 (atom) and 因子 (factor), so read it as a small part that carries out an operation.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语里它原本写作“函数”，“函”是匣子的意思。可以把它记成“放进值，就会出来结果的匣子”。
residual_zh.hook_en: In Japanese it was once written 函数, and 函 means box. Picture a box that gives back a result when you put a value in.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 英语为 data type。type 意为“型”“种类”，日语的“型”正是这个词的译法。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese 型 (kata) is simply a translation of "type", which means a kind or category.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日文「演」是表演的「演」。可以联想到拿到剧本（指令）后才登台的演员。
residual_zh.hook_en: The kanji 演 means "to perform", as on a stage: picture an actor who goes on only after receiving the script, which here is the instruction.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日文「制」有管束、按规矩约束之意。从字面就能读出它是统管全局的角色。
residual_zh.hook_en: The kanji 制 carries the sense of regulating and keeping things in order, a reminder that this function runs the whole show.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 这个词是在 [[jp:揮発]] 前加上表示否定的“不”。不会飞走 = 会保留，从字的构成就能记住。
residual_zh.hook_en: The word adds the negating 不 ("not") in front of [[jp:揮発]]. Not flying off means staying, which the makeup of the word itself tells you.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “液压”二字直接表明了靠什么的力量来推动——液体（油）的压力。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese name 油圧 combines "oil" and "pressure," telling you exactly what does the pushing; the English "hydraulic" likewise points to liquid.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语 [[jp:基地局]] 里的“局”，和 [[jp:放送局]]（广播电台）、[[jp:郵便局]]（邮局）里的一样，指承担某项业务的据点。
residual_zh.hook_en: The character 局 in [[jp:基地局]] also appears in the Japanese words for broadcaster and post office, marking a site in charge of a service.

residual_zh.hook_zh: “漏”字是水从容器里漏出来。可以想象里面的东西向外渗出来记住它。
residual_zh.hook_en: The kanji 漏 depicts water dripping out of a container. Remember it as the contents seeping outside.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 由“破（破裂）”和“损（损害）”组合而成。理解为形状坏了、价值减少了。
residual_zh.hook_en: The word combines 破 (to tear or break) and 損 (to impair). Read it as the form breaking and the value dropping.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语“可用”可读作“可以使用”。英文 Availability 也来自 available（就在手边、随时能用）。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese 可用 reads as "can be used". The English Availability likewise comes from available, meaning at hand and ready to use.

residual_zh.hook_zh: 日语“真正”写作“真（真货）且正（正确）”。英文 Authenticity 来自 authentic（真正的），与表示认证的 authentication 属于同一家族的词。
residual_zh.hook_en: The Japanese 真正 combines "true" and "right". Authenticity comes from authentic (genuine) and belongs to the same word family as authentication.
